verdict.rationale: Kong publishes a structured Konnect AI Gateway v1 API reference with OpenAPI-style operation entries (operationId, summary, description) in a markdown-rendered form, which points to an underlying spec. However, no downloadable OpenAPI file is evidenced, and probes of standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. missing for 10: an explicitly downloadable OpenAPI/JSON/YAML spec file, documentation of where to fetch it, independent confirmation that the spec is complete and usable by tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
